findings.title: Two consecutive non-regression epochs with overlapping file touches — escalation threshold met
findings.evidence: Epoch 4: 2 files changed, regression_added=false (escalation-duplicate-epochs). Epoch 5: 24 files changed, regression_added=false (runstate-missing-crash). Both touched packages/core/src/run.ts and tests/playbook-loop-seed.test.ts. Journal contains duplicate Epoch 003 entry. Touched-files.jsonl has duplicated lines for epoch 003.
findings.suggested_fix: Add regression coverage for stale manifest after fixture mutation: create a test that compiles a playbook, copies and edits a fixture TASK.md, re-compiles, and asserts the manifest changed. This breaks the loop's cycle of re-touching the same core files without expanding coverage.
